title: Cited answers
statement: A node answers questions from its own documents, with source citations, using small local models. When the answer is not there, it says "insufficient knowledge."
how_checked: Run the answer key. Q04, Q05, Q07 to Q21 and Q25 need the right answer and source. Q06 must state the conflict between sources. Q22 to Q24 must be refused with "insufficient knowledge."
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: Knowledge lifecycle
statement: DOC, DOCX and PDF files are ingested with metadata and split into chunks. A new version becomes the active one, old versions are kept, and duplicates and overlaps are detected.
how_checked: Q01 and Q02 must give the version 2 figures. Q26 must give version 1 when asked for January. Q03 must cite the shift rules once, not twice. Unit tests cover versioning, chunk boundaries, and duplicate rules.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: Organization model
statement: Layers and nodes are defined in a registry, for any field of activity. A node can only use its own knowledge.
how_checked: The registry passes its rules: one root, and each layer is its parent's layer plus 1. Q22 is refused because N6 cannot see the Water Dept's documents. Q20, Q21 and Q24 test the terminal nodes.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: Issues
statement: A node breaks a problem into sub-issues, compares it with existing issues, links it to knowledge and executors, suggests probable solutions, and tracks status and progress with fixed rules.
how_checked: Unit tests on status, progress, sub-issue, and relationship rules. Compare the suggested sub-issues for I01 with I02 to I04 in the issues file.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: Projects, priorities and gaps
statement: A node records completed projects, research, achievements and challenges, ranks its key issues, and flags research gaps.
how_checked: The system flags the Route 7 versus Route 12 conflict (Q06) and the missing metro budget (Q23) as research gaps. The ranking of the 7 issues is the same on every run.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: Transfer and judge
statement: A node processes its knowledge in cycles and builds a transfer package at the detail level its parent's layer needs. An LLM judge scores it out of 20, and 18 or more is accepted. The parent can request the latest accepted package offline, stored as CSV or in a local database.
how_checked: Build packages up the chain from N6 to N4, N1, and N0. Score about 20 packages yourself, compare with the judge, and confirm a package under 18 is not sent.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: Engineering foundations
statement: The software follows Domain-Driven Design, runs fully offline, has unit tests for its domain logic, and has clear metrics for each main component, reviewed with the supervisor.
how_checked: Run with the network off. Run the unit tests with a stub in place of the LLM. Review the folder structure against the DDD design. Agree the metric targets with the supervisor.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor

title: RFP (built last)
statement: An unsolved issue can produce a draft RFP. Proposals are evaluated against the RFP, and feedback is generated. The proposal makes this a core objective, so it is built in Phase 13 and not dropped.
how_checked: Generate a draft RFP for I06, the unsolved issue. Check that every required section is present, and that each critique of a sample proposal points to an RFP criterion.
target: set in the metrics step, with the supervisor
